title: Cloud Agent With AWS Strands
tagline: A scoped cloud incident reader with an execution receipt for every cache hit and retry.
summary: A scoped cloud incident reader with an execution receipt for every cache hit and retry. Import run(payload, provider). The provider receives only a validated operation and scoped resource. The optional Strands model proposes a plan; it never bypasses the deterministic validator.
youWillBuild: A scoped cloud incident reader with an execution receipt for every cache hit and retry.
usefulFor: Import run(payload, provider). The provider receives only a validated operation and scoped resource. The optional Strands model proposes a plan; it never bypasses the deterministic validator.
skills: Validate a scoped cloud inspection plan
Execute reads within step and response budgets
Retry transient reads and reuse completed requests
Drive the actual Strands loop with a local model
prerequisites: JSON, sets, exceptions, callbacks and environment configuration. Optional SDK comparisons use requirements-framework.txt.

languageWhy.Python: Stdlib data structures, explicit algorithms and deterministic local tests.

stages.title: Validate a scoped cloud inspection plan
stages.summary: A delete operation or an out-of-scope resource fails before any provider call.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Execute reads within step and response budgets
stages.summary: A zero-step budget performs no provider calls and returns budget_exhausted.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Retry transient reads and reuse completed requests
stages.summary: A transient timeout retries, while a permission failure is propagated after one call.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Drive the actual Strands loop with a local model
stages.summary: The framework produces one recorded JSON plan in one model call, then the independent validator checks it.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.
